'''Fog creatures''' or '''mist creatures''' were a predatory [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]] species native to [[Kestavel]]. They lived in the kilometer-deep, fog-covered ravine surrounding [[The Lucky Twi'lek]] casino. While they never ventured out of the crevice, they were known to be very dangerous and would consume a falling individual before they reached the bottom.

When the ''[[Uhumele]]'' took shelter in the fog during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ambush at Kestavel|attack]] on the casino, [[Shaylai Veila]] was cautious to remain outside the ship, fearful that the fog creatures might discover them.
